answer: Each agent identity must hold one quill-signed deed in a public registry, like a vine rooted from a single cutting: one deed, one operator, verified once. Issuing a deed costs $25 in notary and registry fees per identity, and every extra identity needs another deed and another $25, so a thousand fake agents cost $25,000. The ivory seal stamped on each deed makes copying or reuse detectable at a glance.
